turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: What brings you in here today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Hi I'm coming in because I've had this like on and off runny nose and stuffy nose for the past week. Um and I just came to make sure it's not something serious like Covid.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, yeah no I completely understand why you might be worried um with everything going on. So just to get an idea of the timeline, so when did this start?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So it started about I'd say, seven days ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Seven days ago, OK. And was it just a runny nose that started or did you have any other symptoms?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So at first I felt kind of stuffy um and then now it's more runny. Um and no other symptoms.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And are you coughing at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Are you bringing up any discharge from like your nose, or are you coughing any material up?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no. I mean there's some discharge from my nose, like it's runny, but it's it's not yellow or anything, it's clear.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and do you think this issue has gone worse over the last seven days or is it improving at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um I don't think it's improving. It's changed 'cause it used to be stuffy, now it's more of a runny nose. Um but yeah, it seems to be runny, like it's the same amount of runniness for the past couple of days.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And are you having any symptoms of loss of smell at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no loss of smell.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How about loss of taste?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um were you uh with anyone around you sick at all before those seven days?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh I don't think so, I visited my sister and she has a nephew who goes to daycare, but my nephew's been OK, no, no runny nose or stuffy nose.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Uhm, and is it just a constant issue that goes on throughout the day or is it worse at night, during the day, how would you describe it?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um it's it's pretty constant throughout the day. It's just it just feels bad at night because it um makes it hard for me to fall asleep.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uh have you tried any medications at all over the counter that would help?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um I tried some antihistamines because I do have seasonal allergies. Uh but they don't seem to be helping.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um any anything that makes your symptoms worse at all, like any exertion or any kind of uh position?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um do you have any shortness of breath or chest pain at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any sore throat or muscle aches?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any uh headaches?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nope.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you traveled at all recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you had any nausea or vomiting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any fevers or chills?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any night sweats or fatigue?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Um any kind of sensation that your heart is racing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any changes in your bowel movements like any constipation or diarrhea?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any changes in your urinary pattern?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Uh any issues with your sleep or appetite?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you lost any weight, significant weight, uh recently in the last few months?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And uh do you have any exposure to like fumes, dust, or like uh carpet, pets, or animals? Anything that you might have an allergic reaction to?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK and currently are you sexually active?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I am.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And um can you just tell me a little a little bit of a detail like about like a partner? Uh and if you've had any new partners recently at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I've been with the same partner for the past five years.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and uh do you have any history of any STI's?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK nice, um, in terms of your uh past medical history, do you have any um diagnoses or anything any medical conditions at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm no, no nothing, nothing long standing.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um anything you take medications for?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Are you allergic to any medications?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh not medications.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Uh any environmental allergies?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Just yeah, some seasonal allergies.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any previous hospitalizations or surgeries?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um I was hospitalized for um Like an appendectomy when I was younger. Um but that's about it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And when was that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: That was when I was 18.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And any complications after that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And uh in terms of your family history, does anyone have any lung conditions, heart conditions, or any cancers?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh nope, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And currently uh do you work?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I do. I work from home though.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And how would you describe your living situation right now?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um I live in an apartment with um my partner and we have a dog.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um and currently, uh do you smoke at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do you use any recreational drugs like marijuana?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh I drink like a glass of wine every other day.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Um yeah, so those were some of the questions I had for you. I know it's a bit concerning because of the pandemic going on and um a runny nose can be a symptom uh of Covid as well, but uh it can also be a symptom of just the common cold or any other virus. Um but since you're having, uh you're symptomatic right now, we will definitely get like a Covid swab test done for you.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: OK.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And if you start having any, just monitor for your symptoms. Um you should have the test back within 48 hours. Until then, uh at least for 14 days you should try to isolate in your own room, wear a mask around uh your partner, uh and not go outside, so just self isolate.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: OK.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And and then you will get the test results back in a, hopefully in a few days. So do you have any questions at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, thank you, that was good.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Take care, bye
